title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
source: recorded by J.Cooper: Hitachi trq-222 stereo casstte recoder using 2 hitachi mics and a 120 minute tape.

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality audience tape captures a tight, high‑energy show highlighted by a phenomenal The Other One and a fiery Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its power and tightness, with several reviewers calling The Other One “phenomenal” and noting the excitement of Casey Jones. Recording quality is described as lower‑grade taping with some song cuts, though the drum sound remains clear and unmistakable. Overall the three‑set concert (including an acoustic New Riders set) is regarded as a standout Dead show despite the modest audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, enthusiastic comments about the musical performance (high show rating) offset by consistent notes of sub‑par recording quality, yielding an overall high but not perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Lower‑grade taping with some song cuts; drums are clear and unmistakable, but overall clarity and balance are limited compared to a soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set concert with an electric first set, an acoustic middle set featuring the New Riders, and a high‑energy third set; vibe described as tight and powerful throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums sound unmistakable and tight, contributing to the show's strong momentum.
